女：How much is this sweater?（這件毛衣多少錢？）

女：What!? That’s too much.（什麼！？太貴了。）
男：Well. It’s handmade and you seldom see this kind of the sweater. This is the last one we have.（嗯。這是手工製，而且這件毛衣款式很少見。這件毛衣是我們最後一件。）
女：I’ll give you three thousand.（我付你三千元。）
男：Not possible. Three thousand three hundred. Can’t be lower.（不可能。三千三百元，不能再更低了。）
女：Three thousand two hundred?（三千兩百元？）
男：All right then.（好吧。）
女：OK. I’ll take it.（好的。我買了。）
問：How much is the woman paying for the sweater?（這個女人付多少錢買毛衣？）
錄音稿：W: How much is this sweater?
M: It’s three thousand five hundred dollars.
W: What!? That’s too much.
M: Well. It’s handmade and you seldom see this kind of the sweater. This is the last one we have.
W: I’ll give you three thousand.
M: Not possible. Three thousand three hundred. Can’t be lower.
W: Three thousand two hundred?
M: All right then.
W: OK. I’ll take it.
Q: How much is the woman paying for the sweater?
